profile.summary:
Distributed Systems Software Engineer | 6+ Years Amazon Experience

So far at Amazon I've architected large-scale systems across AWS public services and internal platforms, with a focus on multi-tenant architectures, operational reliability, and performance optimization under high-volume constraints.

Personal website -- https://dandersen.net/
Personal blog -- https://blog.dandersen.net/
github -- https://github.com/dayandersen/

Experience Samples:
* Built content review infrastructure processing 1.2M+ monthly operations with sub-second response times and built-in de-duplication capabilities. Results: Saving 450 operator hours/month (and growing)
* Designed multi-tenant APIs supporting compliance workflows across organizational boundaries. Results: 64% reduction in tenant onboarding time (11 weeks → 4 weeks).
* Led DataSync Discovery architecture from concept to public AWS service launch within C-Suite timeline constraints.
* Diagnosed ETL bottlenecks through systematic analysis of NoSQL access patterns and infrastructure utilization. Results: $5M+ annual cost reduction. 

Leadership Experience:
Mentored 10+ engineers through complex technical deliverables and career advancement. Established testing frameworks reducing deployment failures across multiple services. Led cross-functional teams through security reviews, stakeholder alignment, and operational readiness reviews.

Tech Knowledge:
Java, Kotlin, Typescript, AWS (Lambda, ECS, EC2, AWS Networking, DynamoDB, S3, CloudFormation), distributed systems design, Infrastructure as Code, performance profiling.

Current Work Focus:
Building fault-tolerant, high-throughput content review systems with operational self-service capabilities. Emphasis on eliminating manual intervention points while maintaining compliance and security requirements.

Current Freetime Focus:
* Building a cute little robot https://github.com/dayandersen/robotics
* Building a social network app.
* Building agentic tools for helping me better interact with my local communities law makers.
